# Kal Walkden

> Technology and product executive helping business leaders identify constraints, make decisions, and lead operational and technical change.

This is Kal Walkden's personal website. Blog posts reflect their original publication dates.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://walkden.me/): Professional background and technology and product leadership work.
- [How I Help](https://walkden.me/#how-i-help): Services and ways to work together.
- [Selected Work](https://walkden.me/#selected-work): Examples of past work.
- [About](https://walkden.me/#about): Biography.
- [Contact](https://walkden.me/#contact): Contact form.
- [Writing](https://walkden.me/blog/): Published articles, with links to their canonical pages.

## Optional

- [RSS feed](https://walkden.me/feed.xml): Article summaries and canonical links.
- [Sitemap](https://walkden.me/sitemap.xml): Canonical page URLs.

Use /blog/ URLs when citing articles. Year/month .html paths are compatibility pages for historical links.
